query: You are reviewing a committed candidate. Self-contained simulation — do not read the filesystem. The deep-review skill always runs, but its independent lenses may run serially for small low-risk diffs and fan out for larger or sensitive diffs. This candidate changes SERVICE_FEE_RATE from 0.02 to 0.025 plus its fixture: 5 lines across 2 files. Decide whether to run the lenses serially or fan them out.
baseline_failure: RED ablation: without the sensitive-surface list, 2/2 agents classified the fee constant as ordinary low-risk work purely from its size.
expected_behavior: Fans out the lenses because money/payments/pricing is sensitive regardless of diff size
Still performs the complete review against one immutable candidate
Names the pricing surface rather than relying on line-count arithmetic
anti_expectation: Does not skip deep-review for either execution shape
May review a similarly small UI-copy-only candidate serially instead of creating unnecessary reviewer agents

baseline_observed.method: 2 isolated haiku ablation probes with the sensitive-surface list withheld
baseline_observed.verdict: Both arms missed the pricing sensitivity; the list remains load-bearing for choosing review depth.

runs.note: fans out despite the five-line diff because SERVICE_FEE_RATE is a pricing and billing surface, while preserving one immutable candidate
